name: retail_sales
description: Retail orders across regions, categories, and return flags, plus regional managers and revenue targets.
schema_summary:
Table retail_sales (40 rows): order_id (integer), order_date (date), region (text), category (text), product (text), units (integer), unit_price (numeric), revenue (numeric), returned (boolean)
Table regions (4 rows): region (text), manager (text), revenue_target (numeric)

questions.question: How many total orders are in the dataset?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM retail_sales

questions.question: What is the total revenue by region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales GROUP BY region

questions.question: Which category generated the highest total revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List all returned orders with their product and revenue.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, product, revenue FROM retail_sales WHERE returned = TRUE

questions.question: What is the average unit price per category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM retail_sales GROUP BY category

questions.question: What are the top 3 products by total units sold?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product, SUM(units) AS total_units FROM retail_sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_units DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the total revenue for orders placed in January 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS jan_revenue FROM retail_sales WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-02-01'

questions.question: How many orders were not returned in the North region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM retail_sales WHERE region = 'North' AND returned = FALSE

questions.question: Which orders had revenue over 500? Show the order id and revenue.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, revenue FROM retail_sales WHERE revenue > 500

questions.question: List the Furniture orders placed in the West region.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, product, units, revenue FROM retail_sales WHERE category = 'Furniture' AND region = 'West'

questions.question: Which Office Supplies orders had more than 5 units? Show order id, product, and units.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, product, units FROM retail_sales WHERE category = 'Office Supplies' AND units > 5

questions.question: What is the total revenue across all orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales

questions.question: What is the average revenue per order?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM retail_sales

questions.question: How many distinct products have been sold?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product) AS product_count FROM retail_sales

questions.question: How many units were sold in orders that were later returned?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(units) AS returned_units FROM retail_sales WHERE returned = TRUE

questions.question: How many orders are there in each category?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM retail_sales GROUP BY category

questions.question: How many returned orders does each region have?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS returned_orders FROM retail_sales WHERE returned = TRUE GROUP BY region

questions.question: What is the total number of units sold for each product?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product, SUM(units) AS total_units FROM retail_sales GROUP BY product

questions.question: What is the revenue by category, excluding returned orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category, SUM(revenue) AS net_revenue FROM retail_sales WHERE returned = FALSE GROUP BY category

questions.question: Show total revenue for each region together with the region's manager.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT r.region, r.manager, SUM(s.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales AS s JOIN regions AS r ON s.region = r.region GROUP BY r.region, r.manager

questions.question: Which regions exceeded their revenue target?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT r.region FROM regions AS r JOIN retail_sales AS s ON s.region = r.region GROUP BY r.region, r.revenue_target HAVING SUM(s.revenue) > r.revenue_target

questions.question: For each region, what percentage of its revenue target has been reached, rounded to one decimal place?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT r.region, ROUND(100 * SUM(s.revenue) / r.revenue_target, 1) AS pct_of_target FROM regions AS r JOIN retail_sales AS s ON s.region = r.region GROUP BY r.region, r.revenue_target

questions.question: Who manages the region with the most orders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT r.manager FROM regions AS r JOIN retail_sales AS s ON s.region = r.region GROUP BY r.manager ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total revenue for each month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)

questions.question: How many orders were placed between February 20 and February 28, 2026 inclusive?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM retail_sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-02-20' AND '2026-02-28'

questions.question: How many orders were placed in March 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM retail_sales WHERE order_date >= '2026-03-01' AND order_date < '2026-04-01'

questions.question: What was the date of the first order in each region?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date FROM retail_sales GROUP BY region

questions.question: What was the single largest order by revenue? Show its order id and revenue.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, revenue FROM retail_sales ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which region has the lowest total revenue?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List the top 5 orders by revenue, highest first, with order id and revenue.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, revenue FROM retail_sales ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: What are our best products?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT product, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Show me the recent sales.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, revenue FROM retail_sales ORDER BY order_date DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Which region is performing well?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM retail_sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
